mappings.notes: The V2 layer does not invent daily PnL calculation. Missing daily-loss data remains an explicit unavailable state under existing preflight semantics.
The sizing formula uses min across nominal margin, per-trade risk, free margin, coin cap, gross exposure, and portfolio stop-risk. It does not perform hidden tranche-slot division.
Operational fingerprints include job identity, signal family, stop family, entry, sizing, costs, units, window, symbols, leverage, and margin. J0/J1 and J4/J7 produce different fingerprints.
